connect.marksyPassword.hint: not the one from the diary
connect.consent: The diary login and password are checked once, stored encrypted and used only to read the diary a few times a day on school days. Marksy never changes anything in the diary. It copies the children's names and classes, the timetable, marks, absences, homework and teachers' comments from the diary. All of it is kept only on the server this app runs on, with whoever set it up, and is deleted with the family.

invite.haveLogin: I already have a Marksy login
match.title: Diary connected
match.follow.text: Only the diary and what the child does in the app are shared: ready ticks, study time, subject colours and goals. Your members, tags, rules and notifications are yours, theirs are theirs. The other family gets one message, without names.
match.join.text: Its admin confirms the request, and you become a parent there: one family, shared tags and rules.
match.note: There is never a second copy of the child: the diary is read once for both families. Access comes from the diary itself: if your login stops showing the child, the child disappears here too.

finals.legend.terms.quarter: A whole number in a frame is the final the teacher sets at the end of a quarter. A decimal in italics is where it is heading while there is no final: the running quarter’s average, and for the year the value from the quarter finals posted so far. Under a subject: last year’s final.
finals.legend.terms.trimester: A whole number in a frame is the final the teacher sets at the end of a trimester. A decimal in italics is where it is heading while there is no final: the running trimester’s average, and for the year the value from the trimester finals posted so far. Under a subject: last year’s final.
finals.legend.terms.semester: A whole number in a frame is the final the teacher sets at the end of a semester. A decimal in italics is where it is heading while there is no final: the running semester’s average, and for the year the value from the semester finals posted so far. Under a subject: last year’s final.
finals.legend.terms.other: A whole number in a frame is the final the teacher sets at the end of a term. A decimal in italics is where it is heading while there is no final: the running term’s average, and for the year the value from the term finals posted so far. Under a subject: last year’s final.
finals.legend.years.quarter: A whole number in a frame is the year’s final; a decimal in italics is the running year’s value from the quarter finals posted so far (a dash until there is one).
finals.legend.years.trimester: A whole number in a frame is the year’s final; a decimal in italics is the running year’s value from the trimester finals posted so far (a dash until there is one).

finals.legend.years.other: A whole number in a frame is the year’s final; a decimal in italics is the running year’s value from the term finals posted so far (a dash until there is one).
